description: This file defines internal structures and methods for handling gRPC service configuration, including load balancing policies, method configurations, and retry policies.

classes.name: BalancerConfig
classes.description: Represents a load balancing policy configuration with support for JSON marshaling and unmarshaling.

classes.name: MethodConfig
classes.description: Defines configuration options for individual gRPC methods, including timeout, retry policy, and payload size limits.

classes.name: RetryPolicy
classes.description: Specifies retry behavior for gRPC methods, including max attempts, backoff parameters, and retryable status codes.

methods.name: UnmarshalJSON
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data into BalancerConfig, selecting supported load balancing policies.
